questions.example: This is a friendly reminder that the invoice is due on Monday.
questions.exampleZh: 這是一則友善提醒，發票款項將於週一到期。

questions.example: Please check the stock level before we place the next order.
questions.exampleZh: 下次下單前請先確認庫存量。

questions.example: The samples will be sent by courier tomorrow.
questions.exampleZh: 樣品明天會用快遞寄出。

questions.example: Customs clearance usually takes two to three days.
questions.exampleZh: 清關通常需要兩到三天。

questions.example: Our quality control team found some scratches on the boxes.
questions.exampleZh: 我們的品管團隊在箱子上發現了一些刮痕。

questions.example: We need to sign the contract before the first shipment.
questions.exampleZh: 我們需要在第一批出貨前簽好合約。

questions.example: Can you give us an estimate of the shipping cost?
questions.exampleZh: 可以給我們運費的估價嗎？

questions.prompt: 情境：你想請廠商告訴你何時可以出貨，最自然的說法是？
options: You ship when, let me know?
Could you let me know when you can ship the order?
questions.example: Could you let me know when you can ship the order?
questions.exampleZh: 可以請您告訴我何時能出貨嗎？

questions.prompt: 情境：因為你們的錯誤造成廠商麻煩，你要正式道歉，最自然的說法是？
options: We are sorry make you trouble.
questions.example: We apologize for the inconvenience and will fix it today.
questions.exampleZh: 造成不便我們深感抱歉，今天會處理好。

questions.prompt: 情境：你要在信中提醒廠商一項重要資訊（辦公室週五休息），最自然的說法是？
options: Please note that our office will be closed on Friday.
You must know Friday we close.
questions.example: Please note that our office will be closed on Friday.
questions.exampleZh: 請注意，我們辦公室週五休息。
